title: Area Sales Manager / Regional Sales Manager
description:
Hi Greetings from Inspiration manpower!! 
 This post is regarding an opening with our Top MNC client.. 
 Kindly revert back immediately with an updated resume if it is relevant to you. 
 Type of Job- Permanent Job Location- Bengaluru 
 Job Role - Area Sales Manager / Regional Sales Manager Experience: 6 to 15 years 
 Qualification- Any graduate; B.E./Diploma in Civil, Architecture, or Interior Design preferred Notice Period - Immediate - 30Days Shifts: 9.30AM - 6.30PM 
 Please Note - No transportation( Own Vehicle is Must ) Please Note - Need to be flexible to work from office all 6 Days. 

 Job Overview 
 We are looking for an experienced and driven Area Sales Manager / Regional Sales Manager to sales operations for our aluminium and UPVC windows and doors business in Bangalore. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in project sales within the fenestration, faade, or building-materials industry, with an established network of architects, contractors, builders, and interior designers. This role is responsible for end-to-end sales execution from lead generation through order finalization, installation coordination, and customer relationship management. 

 Key Roles & Responsibilities: 

 6 to 15 years (in Sales & Marketing, with aluminium/UPVC windows & doors or related building-materials industry exposure) 
 Generate leads and build a strong sales pipeline by engaging with customers, architects, contractors, and interior designers for enquiries, orders, and design clarifications. Follow up consistently with clients on payment collections and outstanding dues. Invite and host customers at the showroom to showcase displayed products and drive conversions. Log finalized quotations and coordinate with the factory/production team to initiate order processing. Liaise with the sales coordination team to raise and track customer enquiries and quotations. Attend to walk-in showroom customers, ensuring a high-quality consultative sales experience. Coordinate with the installation team to ensure timely and accurate execution of client window/door installations. Work closely with the design team to resolve design clarifications as per client and project requirements. Conduct customer site/office visits as scheduled for presentations, design clarifications, sample approvals, BOQ collection, and final measurement coordination with the installation team. Arrange and escort prospective customers to live project sites to showcase completed work and build credibility. Share quotations with clients via email or WhatsApp, sourced through the sales coordination team, and drive timely closures. 
 Required Knowledge, Skills & Abilities 
 Functional Knowledge - Sales & marketing, customer and personal service, fenestration/building-materials product knowledge Core Skills - Active listening, persuasion & negotiation, coordination, and effective verbal communication Core Abilities - Strong oral comprehension and expression, written comprehension, BOQ reading and quotation handling Preferred Tools - Basic AutoCAD reading, quotation/costing software (e.g. EVA, Window Maker), MS Excel/CRM reporting Other Requirements - Fluency in English, Hindi and Kannada preferred; willingness to travel for client site visits in and out side Bangalore. 
 Candidate Profile We Are Looking For: 
 6 - 15 years of progressive sales experience, with a significant portion in the aluminium, UPVC windows/doors, faade, glazing, or fenestration industry (candidates from adjacent premium building-materials categories will be considered). Demonstrated track record of project sales engaging and closing business through architects, builders, contractors, and interior designers. Experience managing the full sales cycle: lead generation, site visits, BOQ collection, quotation, negotiation, order closure, and post-sale coordination with production and installation teams. Target-driven mindset with a consistent record of achieving monthly, quarterly, and annual sales goals. Strong interpersonal and relationship-management skills, with an existing network in the Bangalore construction/real-estate ecosystem considered a strong advantage. 
 If Interested, Please reach out to below mentioned contact details:

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
Recruitment Lead Technical & Blue-Collar Hiring 
 We are hiring one person to own technician and fire-crew hiring end to end, and to turn a 90 live vacancies backlog into a running pipeline. 
 Title 
 Recruitment Lead — Technical & Blue-Collar Hiring (Assistant Manager / Manager grade) Base location 
 Marol, Mumbai (Elixir Engineering Head office) Hiring geographies 
 Roha and Mahad MIDC belts (Raigad), Vapi–Valsad GIDC belt (Gujarat), Mumbai high-rise properties Reports to 
 CMD Team 
 3 junior recruiters, direct reports from day one External panel 
 7–8 recruitment agencies, plus Naukri, LinkedIn, JobsIndia and field channels Travel 
 8–10 days a month to plant sites, ITI campuses and source districts. Non-negotiable. Current open positions 
 90+ Experience 
 4–6 years in high-volume technical or blue-collar hiring. This is a working lead role, not a supervisory one. You will carry your own requisitions and the team's numbers at the same time. Why this role exists We have over 90 live vacancies across two talent pools that have almost nothing in common, and our present setup is not closing them. Pool 1 — ITI technicians for chemical plants. Utility operators, fitters, electricians, and allied trades deployed at client plants in the Roha and Mahad MIDC belts and the Vapi–Valsad GIDC belt. ITI-qualified, mostly migrant, highly sensitive to accommodation, wage-in-hand and travel distance. Supply does not sit on job portals. It sits in ITI institutes, apprenticeship batches, referral chains and the source districts these workers come from. Pool 2 — Fire marshals and fire system technicians for Mumbai high-rises. Deployed at residential and commercial towers to operate and maintain fire detection, alarm, sprinkler and pump systems. Screened on conduct and reliability as much as on skill, because they sit on a resident-facing post. Shift-based, locally resident, and competed for by facility management and security agencies. Three junior recruiters, eight agencies and three job portals are all in play already. The backlog says the problem is not tool access — it is that nobody owns the pipeline as a system. That is the gap this role fills. What you will own 1. Build a standing technician pipeline, not a reactive one. Open direct channels into ITI institutes and apprenticeship batches across Raigad, Ratnagiri, Sindhudurg, Khandesh, Marathwada and the Gujarat belt, plus the migrant source states our workers already come from. Run bulk drives and walk-in camps at source, not only at site. Build a live bench so a requisition is filled from stock, not from scratch. 2. Build the Mumbai fire-crew channel. Fire marshals and fire system technicians come from a different market — fire safety service companies, facility management firms, security agencies, and fire-and-safety diploma institutes. Build named-source relationships there and a referral engine among the crews we already deploy. 3. Run the agency panel as a performance panel. Eight agencies with no scorecard is eight agencies working at their own pace. Put every agency on a written mandate with fill targets, turnaround times, a replacement guarantee, and a payment structure tied to joining and 90-day survival. Rank them monthly. Cut the bottom, feed the top, and add specialists where the panel has a geographic hole. 4. Lead and raise the three junior recruiters. Split the desk by pool and belt so each recruiter has clear ownership instead of overlapping on the same requisitions. Set daily call and screening targets. Sit in on their screening calls. Train them on the trades — a recruiter who cannot tell a utility operator from a shift fitter will keep sending the wrong profiles. 5. Run recruitment as a measured funnel. Own one tracker that shows, by requisition: sourced, screened, interviewed, selected, offered, joined, and still-on-roll at 90 days. Report leakage weekly with a reason attached to every drop. Offer-to-joining ratio is the number this business lives on, and it is yours. 6. Close the gap between selection and deployment. Medical fitness, documentation, PF and ESIC onboarding, CLRA and contractor compliance, police verification where the posting demands it, safety induction, travel and accommodation. A selected candidate who cannot be put on site is not a fill. Work with HR, Accounts and site in-charges so nobody stalls at this stage. 7. Hold the market intelligence. Know what competing contractors and agencies pay for each trade in each belt, what accommodation and food arrangements they offer, and when a client plant's own hiring drive is about to drain our pool. Bring that back to management before it costs us a crew, not after. Who we are looking for Experience that counts 4–6 years in high-volume hiring of ITI, diploma or trade-certified workers. Two years will do if it was bulk hiring at a manpower staffing firm, an industrial contractor, or a facility management company. Demonstrated volume. Tell us how many people you put on the ground last year, not how many CVs you sourced. Hands-on experience hiring at least two of: utility and boiler operators, fitters, electricians, instrument or maintenance technicians, riggers, welders, fire marshals, fire system or safety technicians, security and FM staff. Experience hiring for or deploying into chemical, pharmaceutical, petrochemical, refinery, engineering, EPC, MEP or facility management environments. Proven field sourcing — ITI and polytechnic campus tie-ups, apprenticeship and NAPS pools, walk-in drives, recruitment camps in source districts, referral schemes. Portal-only recruiters will not clear our screen. Experience managing external recruitment vendors on commercials and SLAs, not just forwarding requirements to them. Capability we will test for You can read a technician's profile properly — trade certification, NCVT or SCVT, apprenticeship, plant and equipment exposure, shift history, safety training. Trade knowledge is screened for, not assumed. You run a funnel on numbers. You can explain your own offer-to-joining ratio and what you did when it fell. You can hold a candidate from offer to joining. Blue-collar offers leak, and the recruiters who win are the ones who stay on the phone. You are comfortable with statutory onboarding: PF, ESIC, CLRA, contract labour documentation, medical fitness, police verification, safety induction. You are comfortable in a tracker or ATS and will keep data clean. Our management reporting runs on it. Non-negotiables Fluent Hindi and Marathi. Working Gujarati is close to essential for the Vapi–Valsad belt. Willing and able to travel 8–10 days a month to sites, institutes and source districts, often at short notice. Based in or willing to relocate to Mumbai or the Navi Mumbai–Raigad corridor. Graduate in any discipline. An MSW, MBA in HR or PGDM in HR is welcome but we will not hold it against a strong field recruiter who has none. Honest with numbers. We would rather hear a shortfall on Monday than a surprise on month end. What will move you to the top of our list You have hired into the Roha, Mahad, Taloja, Patalganga, Vapi, Sarigam or Ankleshwar industrial belts and know the local labour market first-hand. You already hold live relationships with ITI principals, placement officers or training institutes in Maharashtra or Gujarat. You have hired fire and safety manpower — fire marshals, fire system technicians, safety officers — for high-rises, malls, hospitals or IT parks. You have worked inside a manpower staffing or contract-labour business and understand margin, billing rate and deployment economics, not just hiring. You have built or run a referral programme that actually produced joiners. You know the migrant sourcing corridors — Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand, Odisha, West Bengal, Chhattisgarh — and have hired through them. You have handled mobilisation for a project ramp-up, where 40 or 50 people had to be on site by a fixed date. You have run a recruitment drive end to end: venue, outreach, screening panel, selection, offer on the spot. Who this role is not for We are saying this plainly to save everyone's time. IT, ITeS, BPO or white-collar corporate recruiters with no trade or industrial hiring behind them. Recruiters whose entire method is a Naukri search, a bulk mailer and a follow-up call. We already have that capability and it is not clearing the backlog. Anyone who wants a desk job. A meaningful part of this role is on the road, at plant gates, at ITI campuses and in source districts. Anyone uncomfortable being measured weekly on joiners. What we offer A fixed salary benchmarked to the upper half of the market for this profile, plus a quarterly incentive tied to joiners and 180-day retention — so that closing positions pays you, not just pleases us. Ownership. You will not be routing requisitions through four layers. You set the sourcing strategy, you choose the agency panel, you run the team. Budget for drives, campus tie-ups, referral payouts and travel, agreed up front rather than approved case by case. Direct access to management. Escalations on wages, accommodation or client timelines get a decision in days. A clear growth path to Sr. Manager and then Head of Talent Acquisition as our deployment base grows. Compensation: 7.0–8.0 lakh fixed CTC depending on experience and track record, plus a quarterly incentive of 1.5–2.0 lakh a year linked to candidates who join and complete 180 days on roll. Travel, outstation per diem, conveyance and mobile are reimbursed over and above CTC. We pay the incentive on six-month retention rather than on joining, deliberately — a joiner who leaves in 3 months is a vacancy created, not a position filled. How to apply Send your CV to aliasgark@elixirengg.com with the subject line Recruitment Lead — Technical Hiring , and answer these four questions in the body of your mail. We read the answers before we read the CV. 1. How many people did you personally get to join and report to duty in the last 12 months? Break it up by trade or role. 2. What was your offer-to-joining ratio, and what did you do about the drop-offs? 3. Name the sourcing channels you built yourself, outside job portals and agencies. 4. Describe one hiring mandate you failed to close, and what you would do differently. Selection process 1. Online Interview — 30 minutes, on your numbers. 2. Final discussion with management, and reference checks with two past employers or clients. About Elixir Engineering Elixir Engineering Pvt. Ltd. Is a company of repute with over 30 year in the field of Fire Safety and Industrial Utility Operations. Its current strength is 500+ employees deployed across various chemical industries and Highrise buildings. Elixir is charting an ambitious path of growth over the next 3-5 years.It currently has offices in Mumbai, Lote & Valsad.

Job Title: Team Lead Cash Applications & P2P Location: Pune Experience: 8+ years Educational Qualification: Graduate 
 About the department: Our CFO support service team provides a range of finance and accounting services, including ERP implementation, legacy accounting, audit assistance, global outsourcing, GAAP advisory, finance transformation, and health checks / clean-up of books of accounts. By partnering closely with our clients, we take a practical, hands-on approach to strengthen financial operations, improve controls and support long-term compliance and stability. Within the finance transformation business, we work with forward-looking organizations to optimize financial operations, enhance decision-making and align finance with business objectives. Our services span organization structure, technology enablement and process improvement. 
 Whats in it for you? An opportunity to lead a combined finance operations team while working closely with clients and international stakeholders. You will gain exposure to global finance processes across Cash Applications and P2P, ERP systems, team management and opportunities to improve and streamline existing processes. 
 Role Description Lead the day-to-day delivery of Cash Applications and Procure-to-Pay activities for a global client, ensuring service quality, timely delivery and effective issue resolution. The role will be responsible for team management, SLA and KPI performance, stakeholder management, month-end support and continuous improvement across both processes. 
 Key Result Areas: 
 Operational Leadership & Service Delivery: Lead day-to-day operations across Cash Applications and P2P, including workload allocation, prioritisation, capacity planning and team coverage. Monitor agreed productivity, quality and SLA / KPI measures across both processes and proactively address operational risks, bottlenecks and service issues. Cash Applications & P2P Oversight: Provide operational oversight of customer receipt application, unidentified and unapplied cash, reconciliations and foreign-currency items, as well as PO / non-PO invoices, matching and vendor reconciliations. Review complex or aged exceptions and act as the first level of escalation for accounting, transaction and process-related issues. Stakeholder Management & Query Resolution: Work closely with clients, onshore stakeholders, collections, credit control, procurement, business users, vendors and finance teams to resolve queries and operational issues. Provide timely and professional communication on open items, escalations, risks and action plans, maintaining appropriate documentation. Controls, Reporting & Month-End Support: Oversee month-end activities across Cash Applications and P2P, including ageing reviews, reconciliations, reporting and audit support. Ensure adherence to defined controls, SOPs and accounting processes, with appropriate review of key outputs and exceptions. People Management & Development : Coach and support team members, identify training needs and promote cross-training across Cash Applications and P2P to build a flexible and capable team. Conduct regular quality and performance reviews and support effective feedback, knowledge sharing and performance improvement. Process Improvement & Continuous Improvement: Identify recurring issues, lead root-cause analysis and implement corrective actions across both processes. Drive process standardisation, automation and other continuous improvement initiatives and support transitions or ramp-up of new activities.

Job Description Project Manager, VGP VGP is hiring a senior Project Manager with 10+ years of experience to lead new attractions, expansions and refurbishment projects from approval to handover. Role snapshot Item Detail Role title Project Manager 
 Department Projects 
 Location Chennai (with travel to project sites) Reports to Head Projects / Management 
 Experience Minimum 10 years

 Key responsibilities Project planning and coordination Ensure the project is completed on time and within the approved budget Plan and run projects from concept to commissioning: scope, schedule, budget, milestones and resources. Coordinate architects, consultants, contractors, ride and equipment vendors, and internal teams (operations, finance, marketing, legal). Run regular progress reviews, site visits and MIS reporting to management. Track risks, issues and change requests, and escalate early when timelines or costs are at risk. Ensure quality, safety and statutory compliance at every project site. Team collaboration and leadership Lead cross-functional project teams and site staff, setting clear roles and deliverables. Act as the single point of contact between management, consultants and contractors. Align project handover with operations so new attractions open ready to run. Commercial negotiations Lead negotiations with contractors, vendors, landlords and franchise partners on price, payment terms, scope and timelines. Prepare and evaluate tenders, RFQs and quotations, and recommend vendors on cost, quality and delivery. Control project costs against approved budgets and certify contractor bills and milestone payments. Agreements, contracts and bonds Draft, review and manage work orders, purchase orders, service contracts, lease and franchise agreements, with legal counsel where needed. Manage bank guarantees, performance bonds, security deposits, retention money and warranties: issue, track validity, renew or release. Maintain complete contract records and handle claims, variations and disputes. Liaisoning and approvals Obtain and renew approvals and licences from government bodies, such as building plan approvals, Fire NOC, Pollution Control Board consent, electrical safety (CEIG), local body trade licences and police/entertainment licences. Build and maintain working relationships with government departments, local authorities and utility providers. Track statutory timelines and keep all project approvals current. Skills and competencies Project coordination:  strong planning, scheduling and multi-project tracking; working knowledge of MS Project, Primavera or similar tools. Team collaboration:  leads cross-functional teams and external partners with clear, firm communication. Commercial negotiation:  proven record of closing contractor, vendor and partner deals on favourable terms; strong cost estimation and budget control. Agreements and bonds:  sound knowledge of contracts, work orders. Liaisoning:  hands-on experience obtaining statutory approvals and licences in Tamil Nadu or other Indian states, with established government contacts preferred. Reporting:  clear MIS, progress and cost reporting to senior management. Languages:  fluent English and Tamil; Hindi or other regional languages an advantage. Qualifications and experience Education:  Bachelor's degree in Civil, Mechanical or Electrical Engineering, or Construction/Project Management. An MBA or PG in Project Management is an advantage. Experience:  minimum 10 years in project management, including at least 5 years leading projects end to end. Preferred background:  amusement parks, theme parks, hospitality, retail/mall fit-outs, real estate or large commercial construction. Certifications (preferred):  PMO (Project Management Office) and PMC (Project Management Consultancy) certification or equivalent experience; Willing to travel to project sites across India as new locations open. Key performance indicators Projects delivered on schedule and within approved budget. Cost savings achieved through negotiation and tendering. All statutory approvals and licences in place before opening, with zero lapses. Bank guarantees and bonds tracked with no missed renewals or releases. Safety and quality compliance at every site, with no major incidents.

The company brings job seekers, employers, and career opportunities together in one place, making hiring and career advancement more efficient and informed. description:
**Office Admin (FRESERS WELCOME)**

**Company:** TradeGeniuz Capital Private Limited  
**Location:** Chennai (Porur)

ABOUT THE ROLE

TradeGeniuz Capital Private Limited is looking for enthusiastic and results-driven Business Development Executives to support our sales, student admissions, lead generation and business growth activities.

This role involves speaking with prospective customers, explaining our trading education programs, following up on enquiries and converting suitable opportunities into enrolments.

Freshers and candidates with 0–1 year of experience are welcome to apply. Candidates with additional relevant experience will also be considered.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Sales & Student Admissions

* Handle enquiries through phone calls, WhatsApp, social media and office visits. **Make outbound calls to prospective customers and follow up regularly.** Understand customer needs and explain relevant courses, fees and schedules. **Conduct sales conversations, address questions and support enrolments.** Coordinate client meetings, counselling sessions and admission formalities. **Work towards agreed daily activity goals and monthly sales targets.** Maintain professional relationships with customers before and after enrolment. **Explain our education programs accurately without promising guaranteed trading returns.**

2. Lead Generation & Business Development

* Identify potential customers through outreach, referrals and online channels. **Support B2B and B2C business development activities.** Research potential corporate, college and business partnerships. **Contact prospective partners and arrange discussions with management.** Assist in preparing proposals, presentations and follow-up communications. **Identify opportunities to expand our customer base.**

3. Marketing Coordination

* Coordinate with the digital marketing and content teams on lead-generation activities. **Follow up promptly on enquiries generated through campaigns.** Share feedback on lead quality, customer questions and reasons for non-conversion. **Support promotional campaigns and customer outreach.** Track lead sources and sales outcomes to help improve campaign effectiveness.

4. Reporting & Growth Support

* Maintain accurate customer details and follow-up records in a CRM or spreadsheet. **Submit daily activity updates and regular sales reports.** Monitor personal targets, follow-ups and conversion performance. **Research competitors and share customer insights with management.** Suggest improvements to sales conversations and follow-up processes. **Work with the Founder and management on assigned growth initiatives.**

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

* Freshers or candidates with experience in sales, business development, telecalling, admissions or customer service. **Good communication skills in Tamil and English.** Confidence in speaking with customers over the phone and in person. **Interest in sales, marketing and business development.** Good listening, follow-up and relationship-building skills. **Willingness to learn, accept feedback and work towards targets.** Basic computer knowledge, including Excel or Google Sheets. **A business, marketing or MBA background is an added advantage.** Prior trading knowledge is not mandatory.

Previous team-management experience is not required for this executive role.

WHAT WE EXPECT

We are looking for someone who takes initiative, follows up consistently and actively participates in customer conversations and sales.

You should be comfortable making calls, handling enquiries, maintaining records and taking responsibility for your assigned targets.

WHAT WE OFFER

* Salary based on experience, communication skills and assigned responsibilities. **Performance-based incentives.** Opportunity to work with the Founder and management. **Practical exposure to sales, marketing coordination and business development.** Career progression into senior and team-lead roles based on performance.

WORKING HOURS

09:00 AM – 07:00 PM

SALARY

₹15,000 – ₹30,000 per month.

The stated range covers different experience and responsibility levels. The final offer will depend on the candidate’s experience, skills and role scope. Performance-based incentives will be explained during the interview.

title: Driver Recruiter
description:
About MRK and the role

MRK (MetroRide Kids) runs safe, reliable school rides for children across Hyderabad. Parents trust us with their kids every morning and afternoon, so the quality of our drivers is the quality of our service.

As Driver Recruiter, you will own high-volume hiring of gig drivers and DCOs (Driver-cum-Owners) for MRK. You will source, screen, verify and onboard drivers who are safe, punctual and good with children, and keep the pipeline full as we add schools and routes.

Key responsibilities

•     
**Sourcing:**
Run high-volume driver hiring through referrals, driver hubs, stands, transport unions, local agencies, WhatsApp/Facebook groups, job portals (Apna, WorkIndia, Naukri) and walk-in drives.

•     
**DCO acquisition:**
Identify and onboard Driver-cum-Owners with suitable vehicles; explain the earning model, attachment terms and payout cycles clearly.

•     
**Screening:**
Conduct phone and in-person screening for driving skill, route knowledge, punctuality, communication and suitability to ride with children.

•     
**Verification:**
Coordinate document checks (DL, badge, RC, insurance, permit, fitness, PUC, Aadhaar, PAN), police verification and background checks; ensure zero gaps before a driver goes live.

•     
**Driving & vehicle checks:**
Schedule driving tests and vehicle inspections with the operations team.

•     
**Onboarding:**
Run induction on child safety, conduct norms, app usage and SOPs; hand over trained drivers to ops on time for route launches.

•     
**Pipeline & reporting:**
Maintain the candidate tracker and CRM; report daily/weekly funnel numbers (leads, screened, verified, onboarded, active) and turnaround times.

•     
**Retention & re-hiring:**
Track early attrition, collect exit reasons, re-engage dropped-off drivers and build a bench for peak demand and replacements.

•     
**Vendor & community management:**
Build relationships with driver agencies, fleet owners and local networks to keep a steady supply.

Requirements

•     1–5 years of experience hiring gig drivers, DCOs or delivery partners (ride-hailing, school/staff transport, logistics, quick commerce or similar).

•     Proven track record of high-volume, fast-turnaround blue-collar hiring.

•     Strong network of drivers, fleet owners and agencies in Hyderabad.

•     Working knowledge of driver documents, commercial vehicle permits and background verification processes.

•     Fluent in Telugu and Hindi; working English.

•     Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets and a CRM or applicant tracker.

•     Willing to work from the Hyderabad office and travel locally for sourcing drives.

•     Graduate in any discipline.

Good to have

•     Experience hiring for school transport, kids' mobility or other child-safety-sensitive roles.

•     Experience onboarding EV drivers or EV fleet partners.

•     Familiarity with Zoho CRM or Zoho Recruit.

•     Two-wheeler and a valid driving licence for field sourcing.

What we offer

•     Competitive salary with performance incentives on hiring targets.

•     Ownership of driver supply for a fast-growing kids' mobility business.

•     A mission that matters: getting children to school safely every day.

**How to apply:**
Send your CV to hr@metroride.com with the subject line "Driver Recruiter – MRK Hyderabad".

Kenzo Fitness is a premium fitness destination serving members in Mumbai and Pune, offering cutting-edge facilities and personalized training programs. The team is dedicated to holistic well-being, supporting individuals at all fitness levels to achieve sustainable health and performance goals. Members benefit from expert guidance, modern equipment, and a supportive environment designed to make fitness engaging and effective. Kenzo Fitness fosters a vibrant community that encourages long-term lifestyle changes and a transformative fitness experience.
  
**Role Description**
The Sales Executive role at Kenzo Fitness is a full-time, on-site position based in Navi Mumbai. In this role, the Sales Executive engages with walk-in visitors and leads, conducts needs-based consultations, presents membership options, and provides facility tours. Responsibilities include following up on inquiries, managing prospect pipelines, meeting or exceeding membership sales targets, and maintaining accurate records in the sales system. The Sales Executive collaborates with training and front-desk teams to ensure a smooth onboarding experience for new members and represents the brand professionally at all times. The role also involves participating in local marketing initiatives, gathering member feedback, and contributing ideas to improve sales processes and member acquisition.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Demonstrated skills in consultative selling, customer relationship management, and closing memberships or service-based sales.
* Ability to communicate clearly and confidently in person and over phone or messaging platforms, with strong listening and presentation skills.
* Experience using basic computer tools and CRM or membership management systems to track leads, follow-ups, and sales performance.
* Comfort working in a fast-paced, member-focused environment, with strong time management, organization, and problem-solving skills.
* Prior experience in fitness, wellness, hospitality, or retail sales is preferred but not mandatory.
* Motivation to learn about fitness services, willingness to participate in ongoing training, and a professional, inclusive attitude toward all members.
* Minimum educational qualification of a high school diploma; a bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field is an advantage.
* Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, weekends, or holidays as required by gym operating schedules.

title: Store Sales Executive
description:
**Company Description**

Ritik Ceramics is a premium showroom for bathroom, living room, bedroom and kitchen products. Since 2000, we have helped customers visualise and create luxurious personal spaces, led by directors with over two decades of experience.

We are reopening our store in Mumbai at **Kamal Mills, Lower Parel**.

**Growing our team:** With the new showroom opening, we're hiring for our Sales Executive.

**Role Description** The Sales Executive will work full time on-site at our Mumbai showroom, engaging directly with walk-in customers and clients. Responsibilities include understanding customer requirements, presenting product options, explaining features and benefits, and offering customized solutions that align with design preferences and budgets. The role involves preparing quotations, handling order processing, coordinating with internal teams for inventory and delivery, and following up to ensure customer satisfaction. The Sales Executive will also help maintain showroom displays, support promotional activities, and contribute to achieving sales targets while upholding the brand’s premium service standards.

**Qualifications**

* Strong customer service, relationship-building, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage professionally with walk-in clients.
* Sales and negotiation capabilities, including closing deals, upselling, and working toward individual and team sales targets.
* Basic knowledge of interior products, ceramics, or building materials, and ability to learn product features and applications quickly.
* Effective communication skills in English and local languages, with clear presentation and listening abilities.
* Comfort with basic computer tools for billing, quotation preparation and communication.
* Prior retail or showroom sales experience, preferably in luxury or premium products, is an advantage.
* Minimum educational qualification: a bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field is preferred.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

title: Retail Sales Executive
description:
Sales Executive – Furnishings & Home Décor

Department: Retail Sales

Reporting To: Store Manager / Sales Manager

Industry: Home Furnishings, Home Linen & Décor

1. Job Objective

To understand customer requirements, provide suitable product recommendations, deliver an excellent in-store shopping experience, achieve assigned sales targets, and maintain effective follow-ups to convert enquiries into sales.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Customer Handling & Sales

\* Greet customers professionally and understand their needs, preferences, budget, and intended usage.

\* Recommend suitable fabrics, curtains, upholstery, home linen, carpets, rugs, and home décor products.

\* Understand customer requirements regarding colours, designs, textures, measurements, quality, and functionality.

\* Suggest suitable combinations and coordinate products to create a complete furnishing solution.

\* Explain product features, quality, pricing, care instructions, and available customisation options.

\* Convert walk-in customers and enquiries into confirmed orders.

B. Product Knowledge

\* Develop strong knowledge of fabrics, their compositions, textures, durability, and applications.

\* Understand home linen products, including bedsheets, pillow covers, comforters, towels, and bath linen.

\* Learn about carpet types, sizes, materials, designs, and maintenance.

\* Understand décor accessories and their coordination with different interior styles.

\* Keep updated on new arrivals, collections, promotions, and ongoing offers.

C. Sales Targets & Business Development

\* Achieve monthly and individual sales targets assigned by management.

\* Focus on increasing conversion rates, average bill value, and repeat purchases.

\* Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling related products.

\* Build long-term relationships with customers and encourage referrals.

\* Maintain a healthy pipeline of pending enquiries and prospective customers.

D. Sales Follow-Up & Customer Relationship Management

\* Follow up with customers who have received quotations, fabric options, samples, or product recommendations.

\* Contact prospective customers through calls and messages to close pending sales.

\* Maintain records of customer enquiries, quotations, order status, and follow-up dates.

\* Remind customers about pending selections, measurements, approvals, and payments.

\* Maintain regular communication with existing customers to generate repeat business.

E. Day-to-Day Store Operations

\* Ensure the store, displays, shelves, fabric books, samples, and product sections remain organised.

\* Maintain proper product presentation and visual merchandising standards.

\* Check product availability, stock levels, and sample condition.

\* Coordinate with the store, billing, inventory, and dispatch teams for smooth order processing.

\* Prepare quotations, sales orders, and customer details accurately as per company procedures.

\* Ensure timely communication regarding delivery schedules, customisation, and order updates.

\* Maintain accurate records of daily sales, customer visits, enquiries, and pending follow-ups.

F. Teamwork & Coordination

\* Coordinate with colleagues and management to achieve store sales objectives.

\* Communicate customer feedback, product demands, and market trends to the management.

\* Escalate customer complaints and service issues promptly.

\* Follow company policies relating to pricing, discounts, payments, billing, and customer service.

3. Daily Reporting & Accountability

The Sales Executive is expected to maintain and report:

\* Daily sales achieved against the assigned target.

\* Number of customers attended and enquiries generated.

\* Quotations shared and follow-ups completed.

\* Orders confirmed and sales conversions achieved.

\* Pending enquiries and the next follow-up date.

\* High-value opportunities and customer feedback.

4. 4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated on:

\* Achievement of monthly sales targets.

\* Customer enquiry-to-order conversion rate.

\* Number and value of follow-ups converted into sales.

\* Average transaction value and cross-selling performance.

\* Repeat customer sales and customer satisfaction.

\* Accuracy of quotations, orders, and sales records.

\* Store upkeep, discipline, punctuality, and teamwork.

5. Required Skills & Qualifications

\* Graduate with relevant retail sales experience of minimum 2years are required.

\* Good communication, interpersonal, and customer-handling skills.

\* Ability to understand customer needs and recommend suitable products.

\* Basic computer skills and familiarity with billing or sales software.

\* Strong follow-up skills, a target-oriented approach, and attention to detail.

\* Presentable, proactive, organised, and willing to learn product knowledge.

6. Desired Attributes

\* Customer-first attitude.

\* Strong selling and negotiation skills.

\* Ownership of individual sales targets.

\* Professional behaviour and a positive attitude.

\* Consistency in follow-ups and daily reporting.

\* Ability to work collaboratively in a retail environment.

Pay: ₹22,000.00 - ₹31,000.00 per month

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Premier Service Manager
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
**Business Descriptor**
International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
  
  
**Job Introduction**
The Premier Service Manager (PSM) role is a pivotal position within the International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) branch network. IWPB is executing a multiyear growth strategy, pivoted on positioning as a global bank, committed to the long-term India growth story, and bringing to India its full scale of global capabilities. The business is poised for growth and is currently adding 20 more branches in phases to its existing fleet of 26 branches. This role is customer-facing, primarily servicing walk-in customers and managing their requirements to ensure satisfaction. The Premier proposition is a strategic priority for HSBC, and this role supports the Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) in achieving their objectives by enhancing client-facing time and providing outstanding customer experiences.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**

* Provide high-quality support to a team of Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) to achieve income plans through acquisition, cross-sales, retention, and growth.
* Act as the first point of contact for clients in the absence of PRMs, ensuring seamless service and relationship management.
* Build extensive knowledge of HSBC systems and procedures to effectively handle client needs and improve process efficiencies.
* Proactively identify opportunities to enhance customer service and process efficiencies.
* Ensure clients consistently receive professional, premium service that exceeds expectations.
* Maintain high standards of control and operational practices in line with HSBC’s expectations.
* Enhance customer confidence in HSBC’s Global Premier proposition through systematic and regular communication.
* Attain key performance indicators (KPIs) by acquiring new customers and promoting credit card and general insurance products.
* Meet KPIs for referrals and cross-selling opportunities.

**Education Qualifications / Certifications And Requirements**

* Graduate Degree
* Minimum of two to five years of experience in a customer service or banking environment.
* Holistic understanding of branch operations and processes.
* Sound understanding of the company’s customer service requirements.

**Other Requirements (Knowledge And Experience)**

* Exceptional and updated knowledge of banking products, systems, and processes.
* Well-organized with a professional image and extraordinary business focus.
* Strong customer orientation and ability to provide exemplary service.
* Self-motivated with the drive to overachieve on goals and targets.
* Ability to build close relationships with team members and skillful association with support group colleagues.

**Skills**

* Exceptional Communication Skills: Ability to convey information clearly and effectively across various channels.
* Strong Interpersonal Skills: Capable of building and maintaining positive relationships with colleagues and clients.
* Highly Organized: Demonstrates meticulous attention to detail and efficient task management.
* Collaborative Team Player: Works well within a team, contributing to collective goals and fostering a supportive environment.
* Proactive and Efficient: Acts swiftly and decisively to achieve objectives, ensuring timely completion of tasks.

**Regulatory Certifications**
FEDAI, NISM (Demat), and IRDA certifications are preferred or should be obtained / transferred to HSBC mapping within 3 to 6 months of onboarding.
  
  
**Additional Notes**
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
  
  
Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.
  
  
As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
  
  
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
  
  
Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India

title: Manager for Nail Story - CC1/CC2
description:
Job Description: Salon / Studio Manager – Nail Story

**Job Title:** Salon / Studio Manager

**Brand:** Nail Story

**Locations:** Kolkata (Openings across 5 locations: Minto Park, City Centre 1 – Salt Lake, City Centre 2 – Rajarhat, Acropolis Mall, and Paanache Club)

**Job Type:** Full-Time

**Industry:** Beauty, Wellness & Personal Care

Role Overview

Nail Story is looking for vibrant, organized, and customer-centric **Studio Managers** to lead day-to-day operations across our prime Kolkata branches.

As a Studio Manager, you will oversee boutique salon operations, manage a team of talented nail technicians and front-desk executives, drive retail and service sales, ensure impeccable hygiene standards, and deliver an elevated luxury experience to our clientele.

Key Responsibilities1. Daily Operations & Studio Management

* Oversee the end-to-end daily opening and closing procedures of the assigned studio.
* Monitor appointment books, walk-in allocations, and technician assignments to maximize chair utilization and minimize wait times.
* Maintain salon aesthetics, ambient lighting, music, and pristine hygiene/sanitization standards in compliance with brand guidelines.
* Handle petty cash, daily billing reconciliation, point-of-sale (POS) systems, and end-of-day revenue reporting.

2. Team Leadership & People Management

* Lead, mentor, and motivate salon staff, including nail artists, nail technicians, and housekeeping staff.
* Create weekly rosters, manage shift schedules, and approve leave requests without disrupting salon operations.
* Address internal staff grievances and maintain high morale and a professional code of conduct on the floor.
* Partner with the training and HR teams to coordinate upskilling sessions on the latest nail art techniques and product applications.

3. Client Relationship Management (CRM)

* Act as the primary brand ambassador on the floor, greeting high-profile clients and ensuring warm hospitality.
* Efficiently handle customer feedback, service adjustments, complaints, or escalations with tact and professionalism.
* Drive customer retention programs, membership packages, and repeat appointments via phone or WhatsApp follow-ups.

4. Inventory & Stock Control

* Supervise weekly and monthly stock audits for all consumables (gels, acrylics, polishes, tools, sanitizers) and retail merchandise.
* Raise timely purchase orders to avoid stock-outs during peak seasons and festival periods.
* Monitor product usage per service to minimize pilferage, leakage, or wastage.

5. Sales & Business Growth

* Meet and exceed monthly revenue targets for nail services, extensions, nail art, and retail aftercare products.
* Work closely with marketing to promote location-specific campaigns, seasonal discounts, and festival/bridal packages.

Requirements & Qualifications

* **Education:** Graduate in any discipline; certifications or diplomas in Salon Management, Hospitality, or Cosmetology are a strong plus.
* **Experience:** 2–5 years of proven experience as a Salon Manager, Assistant Manager, Floor Manager, or Front Office Executive in a premium nail salon, beauty parlor, spa, or luxury retail/hospitality outlet.
* **Skills:**
* Strong leadership, conflict resolution, and people management skills.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills in English, Hindi, and Bengali.
* Working knowledge of POS software, salon scheduling tools, MS Excel, and digital payment systems.
* Understanding of nail care services, hygiene protocols, and nail enhancement trends.

Compensation & Benefits

* Competitive monthly salary based on experience.
* Performance-based monthly incentives and service commission targets.
* Paid annual leave, festival bonuses, and employee discounts on salon services.

Pay: From ₹15,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: GM/AVP Customer Service & Operations
description:
**Position:**
GM/AVP Customer Service & Operations

**Location:**
Delhi

**Department:**
Operations & Customer Experience

**Position Overview:**

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced leader to join our team as the Head of Customer Service at DocOnline. This senior role will be instrumental in shaping and enhancing the end-to-end customer experience across our Inbound & Outbound Call Centre and all consumer touchpoints, including physical branches. The ideal candidate will lead a high performing team, drive operational efficiency, and implement strategies to improve customer satisfaction, branch service standards, and service-led sales conversions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Leadership & Team Management:

* Provide strategic leadership to the customer service and branch operations teams.
* Build and manage a culture of performance, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Hire, train, and develop team members to drive excellence in customer interactions.
* Set and monitor KPIs for call centre, regional branches, and backend service operations.

2. Customer Experience Management:

* Own the customer journey across all service channels: inbound calls, walk-ins, digital, and backend support.
* Develop strategies to improve CSAT, NPS, First Contact Resolution (FCR), and Average Handling Time (AHT).
* Identify service gaps and implement improvements to ensure seamless and consistent customer experiences.

3. Operations & Process Optimization:

* Lead initiatives to optimize internal processes and eliminate inefficiencies across the service ecosystem.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to streamline call flow, escalation handling, and ticketing systems.
* Utilize data insights to enhance workflows and track key performance indicators across call centre and branches.

4. Technology & CRM Integration:

* Work closely with IT to identify and implement CRM tools, IVRs, and AI-based service solutions.
* Ensure smooth integration of customer service platforms with core operations.
* Drive automation and self-service initiatives to reduce dependency on manual intervention.

5. Branch & Territory Service Oversight:

* Lead multi-location branch service teams, aligning them with the overall customer service vision.
* Standardize service protocols and performance measures across branches.
* Support sales enablement through service by training staff on service-to-sales interactions and upselling opportunities.

6. Quality Control & Feedback Systems:

* Define and enforce quality assurance standards across customer service teams.
* Roll out audits, call monitoring, and service feedback mechanisms to continuously raise service benchmarks.
* Conduct regular coaching sessions and refreshers to improve service delivery.

**Qualifications:**

* 10–15 years of progressive experience in customer service leadership, preferably in digital healthcare, BFSI, telecom, or services sectors.
* Proven expertise in managing large-scale call centre operations and branch networks.
* Hands-on experience with CRM platforms, call analytics, and ticketing systems.
* Strategic mindset with a strong focus on metrics, customer outcomes, and cross functional collaboration.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills with an ability to work across levels and geographies.
* Experience in driving service-led sales, especially in B2C environments, is highly desirable.

**Key Metrics to Drive:**

* Net Promoter Score (NPS) – Gauge customer loyalty and overall experience.
* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) – Measure customer feedback post-interaction.
* Customer Effort Score (CES) – Assess ease of service interaction.
* First Contact Resolution (FCR) – Track issues resolved in the first interaction.
* Average Handling Time (AHT) – Optimize call time without compromising quality.
* Call Abandonment & Escalation Rate – Monitor dropped calls and unresolved escalations.
* Service Level Adherence (SLA Compliance) – Ensure timely response and resolution across touchpoints.
* Ticket Closure Turnaround Time (TAT) – Measure operational agility in resolving issues.
* Agent Utilization & Occupancy Rate – Improve efficiency and productivity of call centre staff.
* CRM Adoption Rate (Branch + Contact Centre) – Ensure all leads, queries, and follow-ups are logged and tracked effectively.
* CRM Hygiene & Data Accuracy Score – Track proper tagging, closure, and documentation of all customer records.
* Branch-wise Service & Sales Performance – Analyze branch productivity, service quality, and contribution to revenue.
* Walk-in to Resolution Time (Branch TAT) – Optimize branch turnaround and service delivery time.
* Cross-sell/Upsell % via Service Channels – Convert inbound service queries into revenue opportunities.
* Inbound vs. Outbound Call Volume Ratio – Maintain optimal call mix for efficiency and engagement.
* Repeat Interaction Ratio – Track recurrence of unresolved or follow-up queries.
* Customer Query to Fulfilment Conversion % – Ensure closure from initiation to outcome.
* Internal Transfer & Manual Escalation Ratio – Reduce non-value-adding transfers and touchpoints.
* Automation vs Manual Process Efficiency – Drive digital adoption and eliminate redundancy.
* Cost per Resolution / Contact – Optimize cost-effectiveness without compromising service quality.
* Referral Generation via Service – Leverage customer delight for brand advocacy.
* Churn Reduction Post-Service % – Retain customers through prompt, empathetic resolutions.
* Sales Through Service Closure % – Measure service-driven revenue contribution.
* Process SLA Breach Rate – Identify failure points and drive compliance.
* Customer Experience Index (composite metric) – Overall measurement of service perception and delivery.

DocOnline is committed to transforming digital healthcare access for millions. If you are passionate about building customer-first cultures, improving service efficiency, and scaling branch-based service excellence, we welcome you to apply.

title: Recruiter Specialist
description:
Position: Senior Recruiter / Senior Talent Acquisition Executive
 Department: Human Resources Talent Acquisition
 Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra
 Experience: 3-6 Years
 Employment Type: Full-Time 
 Job Summary : We are looking for a dynamic, result-oriented and experienced Senior Recruiter to manage end-to-end recruitment across multiple locations in India. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in bulk hiring, retail recruitment, stakeholder management, candidate sourcing and recruitment MIS. The role requires a proactive professional who can independently manage multiple vacancies, ensure timely closures and maintain a strong talent pipeline. Key Roles & Responsibilities 1. End-to-End Recruitment Manage the complete recruitment cycle, from manpower requisition to candidate joining. Source, screen, shortlist and coordinate interviews for suitable candidates. Handle recruitment for frontline, store operations, supervisory, managerial and corporate positions. Ensure timely closure of vacancies as per agreed timelines. Manage multiple hiring requirements across different cities. 2. Sourcing & Talent Pipeline Source candidates through Naukri, LinkedIn, Indeed, employee referrals, social media and other recruitment channels. Build and maintain a strong database of potential candidates. Conduct initial HR screening, including experience, communication skills, salary expectations and notice period. Develop effective sourcing strategies for critical and hard-to-fill positions. 3. Stakeholder Management Coordinate with department heads, store managers, regional managers and management regarding manpower requirements. Schedule interviews and obtain timely feedback from hiring managers. Provide regular recruitment status updates and highlight hiring challenges. Ensure effective communication between candidates and hiring managers. 4. Offer Management & Joining Conduct salary negotiations within approved budgets. Coordinate offer approvals and issuance of offer letters. Follow up with selected candidates until their joining date. Minimise offer dropouts and ensure a smooth handover to the HR Operations team for onboarding. 5. Recruitment MIS & Reporting Maintain accurate daily, weekly and monthly recruitment trackers. Monitor CV sourcing, screening, interview scheduling, selections, offers and actual joinings. Track recruitment performance, including time-to-hire, vacancy ageing, offer acceptance and joining conversion. Submit daily recruitment updates and weekly vacancy-wise progress reports. Identify recruitment bottlenecks and recommend corrective actions. 6. Recruitment Process Improvement Improve sourcing effectiveness and reduce hiring turnaround time. Develop alternative recruitment channels to reduce dependency on external agencies. Support walk-in interviews, recruitment drives and bulk hiring initiatives. Ensure compliance with internal recruitment policies and approval processes. 
 Required Qualifications & Skills : Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR preferred. 3-6 years of relevant experience in end-to-end recruitment. Experience in construction industry preferred. Strong knowledge of job portals and candidate sourcing techniques. Experience in bulk hiring and handling multiple vacancies simultaneously. Excellent communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills. Ability to independently manage recruitment requirements Good working knowledge of MS Excel, recruitment trackers and MIS reporting. Target-oriented, organised and capable of working under tight deadlines. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): Timely closure of approved vacancies. Number of relevant CVs sourced and screened. Interview-to-selection conversion ratio. Offer-to-joining conversion ratio. Reduction in vacancy ageing and hiring turnaround time. Accuracy and timely submission of recruitment MIS. Hiring manager satisfaction and recruitment quality. Preferred Candidate Profile We are looking for a self-driven recruiter who takes ownership of assigned positions, consistently follows up with candidates and hiring managers, and delivers results within agreed timelines.

title: Walk-in || Customer aquisation associate
description:
Time and Venue:
Interview Date: 22 Oct - 06 Nov
Timing: 9.30 AM - 5.30 PM
Venue: 2B/1, Santkrupa Path, Ground Floor, Sr. No. 70, Purushottam Villa, Sinhgad Rd, Vadgaon Budruk, Pune, Maharashtra 411041
Contact: Payal Kathole (8080506940)

JOB DESCRIPTION 
 CUSTOMER ACQUISITION ASSOCIATE 
 Company: Weather Fighter Pvt. Ltd.
 Department: Customer Acquisition / Business Development
 Designation: Customer Acquisition Associate
 Reporting To: Senior Customer Acquisition Associate / Customer Acquisition Manager / Market Growth Manager
 Location: Pune 
 Employment Type: Full-Time

 1. JOB PURPOSE 
The Customer Acquisition Associate is responsible for generating new business leads, contacting potential customers, understanding their requirements, qualifying prospects, arranging customer meetings and site visits, and supporting the sales team in converting leads into business opportunities.
The role will primarily focus on B2B customer acquisition for Weather Fighter's industrial waterproofing, epoxy flooring, PU flooring, protective coatings, construction chemicals, and related services.
The employee will be an important first point of contact between the company and prospective customers.

 2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 
 A. Lead Generation 
Generate new business leads through:
 Outbound calling Existing customer database IndiaMART Justdial Sulekha LinkedIn Google/business directories Website enquiries WhatsApp Email References Contractor networks Architect/consultant networks Exhibitions and events Project databases Market research Identify potential B2B customers and initiate contact. Introduce Weather Fighter and its relevant products/services. Generate qualified enquiries for the sales and technical team. 
 3. OUTBOUND CALLING 
 Make regular outbound calls to potential customers. Contact industries, factories, builders, contractors, architects, consultants, purchase teams, facility managers, project managers, and other relevant decision-makers. Introduce the company professionally. Understand customer requirements through appropriate questions. Identify upcoming or ongoing projects. Explain the company's relevant services. Generate interest and arrange further discussions. Maintain professional telephone etiquette. Follow the approved company calling process and communication standards. 
 4. CUSTOMER REQUIREMENT IDENTIFICATION 
Understand whether the customer has requirements related to:
 Industrial Waterproofing Epoxy Flooring PU Flooring Industrial Flooring Protective Coatings Anti-Corrosive Coatings Heat-Insulation Coatings Fire-Retardant Coatings Electrical Insulation Coatings Construction Chemicals Waterproofing Chemicals & Membranes Sealants Epoxy Grouts Tile Adhesives Customized Coating Solutions Collect basic information regarding:
 Type of requirement Project location Project stage Approximate area/quantity Expected timeline Customer/company details Decision-maker details Current supplier, where applicable Expected next action 
 5. LEAD QUALIFICATION 
Evaluate leads based on:
 Customer 
 Company name Contact person Designation Mobile number Email ID Location Industry Requirement 
 Product/service required Project type Project location Requirement quantity/area Project stage Expected purchase timeline Opportunity 
 Budget/potential value where available Decision-maker Contractor/consultant involvement Probability of conversion Only relevant and properly qualified leads should be transferred to the concerned sales/technical team.

 6. APPOINTMENT GENERATION 
 Schedule meetings between customers and the sales/technical team. Arrange site visits where required. Confirm appointments with customers. Share complete customer and project information with the concerned executive. Follow up after meetings. Record meeting outcomes in CRM. Schedule the next follow-up/action. 
 7. LEAD FOLLOW-UP 
 Follow up with all qualified leads according to the defined schedule. Contact prospects through calls, WhatsApp, or email. Follow up on customer requirements. Track project timelines. Reconnect with future prospects when the project becomes active. Reactivate old and inactive leads. Ensure no qualified lead is neglected. Escalate high-potential leads to the reporting manager. 
 8. CUSTOMER DATABASE MANAGEMENT 
 Create and maintain an accurate customer database. Research potential companies and decision-makers. Collect relevant contact information. Categorize prospects according to: City Industry Customer type Project type Requirement Lead status 
 Remove duplicate or irrelevant records. Continuously expand the prospect database. 
 9. CRM MANAGEMENT 
CRM/software usage is mandatory.
The employee must:
 Enter every new lead into CRM. Update customer details. Record calls and conversations. Record requirements. Update lead status. Enter next follow-up date. Record appointments. Update meeting/site-visit information. Maintain accurate lead sources. Update transferred leads. Maintain daily CRM discipline. Suggested Lead Flow 
 New Lead Contacted Connected Interested Qualified Appointment Site Visit Technical Discussion Quotation Negotiation Order / Future Follow-up / Lost 

 10. SALES TEAM COORDINATION 
 Transfer qualified leads to the appropriate sales executive. Provide complete customer and project information. Coordinate meetings and site visits. Share customer requirements with the technical team. Follow up with the sales team regarding lead progress. Ensure proper handover of every qualified opportunity. Support the sales team with additional customer information when required. 
 11. MARKET & PROJECT RESEARCH 
 Identify potential construction and industrial projects. Search for companies requiring industrial flooring, waterproofing, coatings, or construction chemicals. Identify relevant contractors, builders, architects, and consultants. Collect basic project information. Add potential projects to the CRM/database. Share promising opportunities with the reporting manager. 
 12. CUSTOMER RELATIONSHIP DEVELOPMENT 
Maintain professional relationships with:
 Industrial companies Builders Contractors Architects Consultants Facility managers Purchase departments Project managers Dealers and distributors Applicators The objective is to create long-term business relationships and future sales opportunities .

 13. DAILY WORK RESPONSIBILITIES 
 Morning 
 Review new leads. Review pending follow-ups. Prepare daily calling plan. Prioritize high-potential leads. During Working Hours 
 Outbound calls. Lead generation. Customer qualification. Appointment generation. Follow-ups. Database research. Customer communication. CRM updates. Coordination with sales/technical teams. End of Day 
 Update CRM. Complete pending follow-ups. Update lead status. Submit daily activity report. Prepare the next day's follow-up plan. 
 14. KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS (KPIs) 
Performance will be measured on:
 Lead Generation 
 Number of new leads generated. Number of qualified leads. Lead quality. New companies identified. Calling 
 Daily outbound calls. Connected calls. Meaningful conversations. Follow-up calls. Customer Acquisition 
 Qualified opportunities generated. New customer meetings. Site visits generated. Sales opportunities created. Conversion Support 
 Lead-to-qualified-lead conversion. Appointment-to-opportunity conversion. Opportunities converted to sales. CRM 
 Daily CRM updates. Accurate customer data. Follow-up discipline. Reporting accuracy. 
 15. QUALIFICATION 
 Preferred Qualification 
 Graduate in any discipline. BBA / B.Com / BA / B.Sc. or equivalent qualification preferred. Diploma/degree in Civil Engineering or a technical field will be an advantage. 
 16. EXPERIENCE 
 Preferred Experience: 02 years 
Experience in:
 Telecalling Customer Acquisition B2B Sales Lead Generation Business Development Inside Sales Construction Chemicals Building Materials Waterproofing Flooring Paints & Coatings will be an advantage.
 Freshers may also be considered if they demonstrate strong communication skills, confidence, willingness to learn, and a target-oriented approach.

 17. REQUIRED SKILLS 
 Communication 
 Good verbal communication. Professional telephone etiquette. Basic email and WhatsApp communication. Ability to speak confidently with customers. Sales 
 Lead generation. Prospecting. Customer qualification. Follow-up. Appointment setting. Relationship building. Basic convincing skills. Computer 
 Basic MS Excel. MS Word. Email. CRM/software. Internet research. WhatsApp Business. Basic data entry. 
 18. PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES 
The ideal candidate should be:
 Energetic. Confident. Proactive. Target-oriented. Good at communication. Persistent with follow-ups. Customer-focused. Organized. Self-motivated. Comfortable with outbound calling. Willing to learn. Able to handle rejection positively. Responsible for daily reporting. 
 19. ROLE EXPECTATION 
The Customer Acquisition Associate is expected to take ownership of the first stage of the customer journey:
 Identify Contact Understand Qualify Follow Up Schedule Meeting Handover Track 
The employee should focus on generating genuine and qualified business opportunities , not merely increasing the number of calls.

 20. CAREER GROWTH 
 Customer Acquisition Associate 

 Senior Customer Acquisition Associate 

 Customer Acquisition Team Leader / Manager 

 Market Growth Associate 

 Market Growth Officer 

 Project Growth Manager 

 Regional Growth & Operations Head 

 Zonal Growth Head / Business Head 

 21. IDEAL CANDIDATE PROFILE 
The ideal candidate should have a strong communication ability, positive attitude, customer-handling skills, disciplined follow-up approach, and willingness to work towards measurable targets .
The person should be comfortable with regular outbound calling and should have the ability to identify genuine customer requirements and convert them into qualified opportunities for the company's sales and technical teams.
 Core Success Formula 
 Calling + Lead Generation + Qualification + Follow-up + Appointment + CRM Discipline = Customer Acquisition

Follow up on quotations. Coordinate quotation revisions. Inform senior team members about customer feedback and competitor pricing. Support the sales team during negotiations.

Every opportunity must have a defined next action and expected timeline .

The employee is expected to:
 Generate new business leads. Develop new customers. Generate project enquiries. Support technical approvals. Develop consultants and contractors. Generate product trials. Convert enquiries into orders. Support achievement of sales targets. Generate repeat business. Cross-sell and up-sell suitable products.

Assist in technical meetings. Support project handover after order confirmation. Assist project teams in resolving initial technical queries.

Coordinate corrective action. Follow up until resolution. Maintain complaint records. Communicate professionally with customers.

 Customer visits Site visits Contractor meetings Consultant meetings Architect meetings New project identification Lead generation Technical presentations Product demonstrations Product trials Quotation follow-ups Business follow-ups Activity quality, lead quality, conversion, and revenue contribution will be evaluatednot only the number of visits.

Experience in waterproofing, flooring, industrial coatings, construction chemicals, or related industries will be an advantage.

The ideal candidate should be a field-oriented technical professional with a strong interest in business development .

 Job Description 
 Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end lateral recruitment for domestic IT staffing requirements. Source candidates through Naukri , LinkedIn , job portals, referrals, and other recruitment channels. Screen resumes, conduct initial candidate assessments, and evaluate technical skills against job requirements. Understand IT Services hiring requirements across Data Science, AI/ML, Data Engineering, Power BI, and other IT technologies. Use Boolean search strings and advanced sourcing techniques to identify relevant candidates. Work with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and maintain accurate recruitment trackers and candidate databases. Coordinate interviews, manage interview schedules, and ensure timely candidate and client follow-ups. Handle client coordination, stakeholder management, and vendor management throughout the recruitment lifecycle. Manage candidate communication, salary negotiations, offer follow-ups, documentation, and onboarding coordination. Use ChatGPT, Claude, and other AI tools to improve sourcing, screening, recruitment communication, and day-to-day productivity. Prepare recruitment reports, hiring dashboards, and trackers using MS Excel, Google Sheets, PowerPoint, and Power BI. Support walk-in drives, mass interview scheduling, and weekend recruitment activities whenever required by business needs. 
 Mandatory Skills & Qualifications 2 to 3 years of hands-on experience in IT recruitment or IT staffing . Currently working with an IT company, IT consultancy, or US/UK IT staffing organization, with a willingness to transition to Domestic IT Staffing. Good understanding of IT staffing , lateral hiring, and recruitment lifecycle processes. Knowledge of Data Science, AI/ML, Data Engineering, Power BI, and IT Services hiring. Hands-on experience with ATS platforms, Boolean search strings, and advanced candidate sourcing. Experience in client handling, stakeholder management, vendor coordination, and interview scheduling. Working knowledge of ChatGPT/Claude, MS Excel, Google Sheets, and PowerPoint . Familiarity with Power BI reporting is an advantage. Exceptional communication skills in English. Strong follow-up, coordination, negotiation, and time-management skills. A proactive mindset with the ability to handle new challenges, changing priorities, and multiple hiring requirements. Flexibility to support weekend walk-in drives , mass interview scheduling, or recruitment activities when required. 
 Preferred Candidate Profile We are looking for someone who is target-oriented, adaptable, resourceful, and passionate about recruitment . Candidates who can independently manage hiring requirements, build strong candidate pipelines, coordinate effectively with clients and stakeholders, and deliver within recruitment timelines are encouraged to apply. 
 Please Do Not Apply If: You are a fresher. You have more than 3 years of experience. Your notice period exceeds 30 days. You do not have hands-on experience in IT Recruitment. You are working as a freelancer. You are not passionate about recruitment and talent acquisition.
